factors.name: revenueScaleAcceleration
factors.basis: Nebius's SEC-furnished Q2 2026 shareholder materials report Q2 group revenue of approximately $582M, up 454% year over year, and more than $2.3B of positive operating cash flow in the quarter.

factors.name: contractEconomicsSignal
factors.basis: The SEC-furnished shareholder letter states four Q2 deals averaged more than $1B each, Q2 deal ACV per MW exceeded $20M versus a stated 2026 base of $12M, and estimated payback for new Q2 deals was 1 year 10 months based on forecast costs and contracted future capacity.

risks: The payback period and ACV-per-MW metrics are management estimates and include forecast costs and capacity not yet built; they are not realized returns.
Large customer contracts and infrastructure scale-up increase concentration, construction, power, GPU-supply and commissioning exposure.
unknowns: The cited materials do not independently validate management's forecast payback assumptions.
Alpha still owns factor mapping, numeric underwriting and confidence calibration.

factors.name: operatingExecution
factors.basis: SEC-furnished Q2 2026 materials report Nebius AI cloud adjusted EBITDA margin of 50% and approximately $8B cash at quarter end, alongside the reported revenue acceleration.

factors.name: capacityExecution
factors.basis: The Q2 shareholder materials raised year-end 2026 contracted-power guidance to 5 GW and described capacity coming online through 2027.

factors.name: financingCapacity
factors.basis: Nebius subsequently closed $5.75B aggregate principal of new convertible senior notes on August 24, 2026, materially expanding financing capacity while also increasing future repayment and potential dilution exposure.

risks: The $5.75B convertible issuance materially increases debt-like obligations and potential equity dilution.
Reported Q2 execution does not remove future delivery risk on multi-year capacity commitments.
unknowns: Incremental return on capital from the August financing remains unproven until deployed capacity produces realized economics.
Customer-level margins and concentration sensitivity are not fully resolved by these sources.

sources.origin: U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission / Nebius Group N.V.
observedFacts: Q2 2026 group revenue approximately $582M, up 454% year over year.
Approximately $2.3B positive operating cash flow and approximately $8B cash ending Q2.
Nebius AI cloud adjusted EBITDA margin reported at 50%.
Four Q2 deals averaged more than $1B each; Q2 deal ACV per MW reported above $20M versus a $12M 2026 base.
Estimated payback for new Q2 deals stated as 1 year 10 months using forecast costs and contracted future capacity.
Year-end 2026 contracted-power guidance shown at 5 GW.
Closed $3.45B principal of 0.50% convertible notes due 2030 and $2.3B principal of 4.50% convertible notes due 2034, totaling $5.75B aggregate principal.

recommendation: Alpha should use the SEC-furnished Q2 financial and execution data as current source-addressed underwriting inputs, separately model the August $5.75B convertible financing as capacity plus dilution/obligation risk, and retain management-estimate caveats for ACV-per-MW and payback metrics.
